authority: Nutrition Data Foundation D0-D2 + NDS-R1 v0.1

active_questions.title: Information sufficiency before individualized nutrition recommendation
active_questions.question_text: Within the authorized information boundary of EP-NHANES-L-0001, is the currently available information sufficient to support an individualized nutrition recommendation now, or is REQUEST_MORE_INFORMATION / DEFER the scientifically defensible action class; and which missing information categories are decision-critical before an individualized recommendation can be qualified?
authorized_visible_inputs: day1_total_energy = UNKNOWN because source component was not ingested
prohibited_inferences: do not infer a clinical diagnosis
do not infer an unobserved diet pattern or nutrient intake
do not infer medication, disease, laboratory, allergy, preference, goal or longitudinal history not present in the authorized view
do not use future observations or future evidence
do not treat NHANES row values as a real clinical patient record
selection_rationale: real NHANES-grounded D2 object already passes D0 physical/runtime conformance
reference and evaluator are still pending, so the case is suitable for R1 rather than contaminated by an existing Gold
the task directly exercises Foundation rules that information can be insufficient for START while sufficient for ASK/DEFER
the case can expose overconfident recommendation behavior without requiring a fabricated diagnosis

nonclaims: Question selection does not establish that DEFER is the correct final reference.
Question selection does not establish which missing variables are mandatory.
No scientific claim or guideline statement is qualified in A1R.
No source count target is a completion threshold.
